annotations.title: Render HTML to an image or PDF

description: Renders an HTML document you provide as a JPEG, PNG or WebP image, or as a PDF: an invoice, a report, a certificate. Returns a link to the file, and the image itself when it is small enough. Images, fonts and stylesheets referenced by the HTML must use absolute URLs.

format.description: Output type. `jpeg` (default), `png`, `webp`, or `pdf` for a paged document.

height.description: Viewport height in pixels, 150 to 4320. Values outside the range are clamped. Default 1024.

html.description: The HTML document to render, up to 2 MB.

quality.description: JPEG quality from 1 to 100. Sent as 80 when omitted, which keeps most captures small enough to be returned inline. Ignored for other formats.

width.description: Viewport width in pixels, 200 to 3840. Values outside the range are clamped. Default 1280.

name: render_html
title: Render HTML to an image or PDF
